statement: The frozen existential assertion in source.md is true.  Let h have ordered real basis (e1,e2,r,z), with the only nonzero brackets up to skew-symmetry [e1,e2]=e1+z, [e1,r]=-r, and [z,r]=r.  Let V=span(e1,e2,r) and q=Rz.  This bracket satisfies Jacobi, V Lie-generates h, and kappa_q vanishes on V.  Every complement of V is q_(x,y,t)=R(z-xe1-ye2-tr); its vertical trace character on (e1,e2,r) is (-y,x,0), while its horizontal trace character on the displayed generator is 1+x+y.  Thus vertical balance forces x=y=0, where horizontal balance fails, so no complement of V is modularly balanced.
contribution: This exact rational four-dimensional witness completely proves the frozen bounded assertion and also gives a positive example for the existence clause of Question 1 in arXiv:2609.04299v1.  The graph calculation covers every complement, not a finite sample.  A limited exact-phrase primary-source screen on 2026-09-09 found no separate resolution; no priority claim is made pending independent review.
